reader_summary.overview: The guest shares his strategy of buying young growth companies early and holding them until they become stable value stocks. He emphasizes revenue growth over short-term profits and warns that even big companies can be disrupted. He also discusses his specific views on Duolingo, Nvidia, and Tesla.
